hero.title: “The Path of the Warrior”
hero.lead: The cards you hold are not answers but doors. Behind each one waits a step that will change you forever.

wisdom.heading: Ancient Toltec wisdom
body: The original TARO “Path of the Warrior” was created as a guide into the world of Toltec teachings and traditions. The deck unites an adaptation of tarot structure with ancient knowledge about the Warrior’s path.
wisdom.accent: Mastery, intent, recapitulation, control of attention, and the shift of the assemblage point.
wisdom.sparkle: TARO “Path of the Warrior” reveals this knowledge through the Arcana even if you have never read Carlos Castaneda.
wisdom.finalAccent: Every card is a lesson in power and a step toward transformation.

practiceGate.heading: Each card is a gate into practice
paragraphs: Take an Arcana, study its essence, and apply it in your life. Then the teaching stops being mere text and becomes your own experience.
That is how the Arcana become guides on the warrior’s path, revealing the mystery of perception, energy, and freedom step by step.
practiceGate.quote: There is only one path, and it leads into the unknown. But you must walk it yourself, with open eyes, without fear and without self-pity.

primary.title: XX. Judgement
primary.subtitle: (Major Arcana)
primary.quote: The warrior’s path is a path of rebirth. Each time one grasps a new truth, the old world dies and a new one is born.
primary.description: Judgement symbolizes rebirth, final realization, and the passage into a new level of spiritual development. It speaks directly to Castaneda’s idea that awareness leads to inner renewal.
primary.iframeTitle: Path of the Warrior arcana example

secondary.title: Two of Cups
secondary.subtitle: (Minor Arcana)
secondary.quote: A warrior knows that a true union is the joining of two souls striving toward one aim. Such a union makes them stronger.
secondary.description: The Two of Cups symbolizes love, harmony, and spiritual partnership. The quote reflects a deep unity that makes people stronger on their path.

structure.heading: Deck structure
structure.description: The deck consists of 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana divided into four suits.

stats.label: Major Arcana
stats.text: Stages and concepts of the Warrior’s path.

stats.label: Minor Arcana
stats.text: The practice of power through four suits.

slides.name: Swords
slides.meta: Element - Air, totem birds - raven and eagle.
slides.description: Intellect and clarity, spiritual vision, resilience, and the ability to see beyond the possible.

slides.name: Wands
slides.meta: Fire element, totems - jaguar and panther.
slides.description: They symbolize energy, willpower, the desire for action, and creative motivation.

slides.name: Pentacles
slides.meta: Earth element, totems - bull and buffalo.
slides.description: Practicality, hard work and achievement, balance between the spiritual and material.

slides.name: Cups
slides.meta: The element of water, totems - fish and dolphins.
slides.description: Emotions, intuition, the search for deep meaning, philosophy, and inner harmony.

spread.heading: Interactive card spread
spread.description: Press the button to draw 3 cards at random from a 21-card deck and receive a short reading for each one.

cards.title: The Magician
cards.description: Gather your attention into one point and take the first precise step.

cards.title: The High Priestess
cards.description: Listen to the knowledge that arrives before words.

cards.title: The Empress
cards.description: Let the form ripen without forcing the natural motion of power.

cards.title: The Emperor
cards.description: Check the boundaries and reclaim your right to act.

cards.title: The Hierophant
cards.description: Separate living knowledge from familiar dogma.

cards.title: The Lovers
cards.description: Choose the union that strengthens your path.

cards.title: The Chariot
cards.description: Direct your energy where a breakthrough is needed.

cards.title: Strength
cards.description: Hold emotion without suppression and without surrender.

cards.title: The Hermit
cards.description: Step inward to see the outer road more clearly.

cards.title: Wheel of Fortune
cards.description: Notice the cycle and enter it consciously.

cards.title: Justice
cards.description: Name the true price of the choice and accept it.

cards.title: The Hanged Man
cards.description: Shift your point of view until the situation opens another meaning.

cards.title: Death
cards.description: Release the form that has already fulfilled its task.

cards.title: Temperance
cards.description: Gather opposites into one calm movement.

cards.title: The Devil
cards.description: See the attachment that disguises itself as necessity.

cards.title: The Tower
cards.description: Let the false support collapse without bargaining with truth.

cards.title: The Star
cards.description: Trust the intent that leads beyond fear.

cards.title: The Moon
cards.description: Move slowly: uncertainty can also be a guide.

cards.title: The Sun
cards.description: Act openly when power no longer needs a mask.

cards.title: Judgement
cards.description: Accept rebirth and do not return to the old role.

cards.title: The World
cards.description: Complete the circle and claim experience as a new freedom.
